info.name: Player Service
info.description:
Player Service owns the moderator player accounts: identity, credentials, profile, friends, XP, level, shift history and the disciplinary log. It is the only issuer of the player JWT.

THROUGH THE GATEWAY. Every request goes to the Gateway: {{base_url}} is http://localhost:8080/api/v1/player, the one base URL of this collection. The Gateway checks the credential each route accepts and forwards only X-Player-Id: player routes send `Authorization: Bearer {{<player>_token}}`, service-only routes (POST /events, /dev/*, /health/ready) send `X-Service-Token: {{service_token}}`, which must equal SERVICE_TOKEN in the CPR .env. Login and registration are public.

CONTRACT. POST /auth/login, GET /players/{player_id} and POST /events are in the CPR communication contract. Everything else is beyond it and labelled so in the folder names.

TOKENS. The "auth" folder logs in as four seeded players (password `seed-password`) and stores {{dima_token}}, {{maxim_token}}, {{rookie_token}} and {{veteran_token}}; run it first. A player changes only their own account and friends list: another player's token is 403 NOT_ACCOUNT_OWNER.

TESTS. Every request name states the status it expects, and the error code when there is one; a collection-level test asserts both.

TASK LIMITS. The "dev - task timeout" folder shows the 408. The 429 needs parallel requests, which a sequential run cannot send: start Player Service with MAX_CONCURRENT_TASKS=1 and call /dev/slow?ms=3000 twice at once (docs/PLAYER_SERVICE.md, §11).

PREREQUISITES. The team stack from the CPR (docker compose up -d) on a freshly seeded player database. {{dima_id}}, {{maxim_id}} and {{vlad_id}} are the ids the CPR README and the other services' collections already use; {{dima_id}} carries xp 1250 / 12 completed shifts, so the contract's published example response is reproducible verbatim.

ORDER. Folders run top to bottom. Requests whose names start with a number belong to a sequence and depend on the ones before them. The last folder is destructive; drop the player_db volume to restore the seed.

item.name: health
GET /health (200, liveness - public, never touches a dependency)
GET /health/ready (200, readiness - postgres; service token only)
auth (contract) - run first, stores the tokens
login - dima_mod (200, stores dima_token)
login - maxim_jr (200, stores maxim_token)
login - rookie_one (200, stores rookie_token)
login - veteran_max (200, stores veteran_token)
login - wrong password (401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS)
login - unknown username, same answer (401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS)
login - password absent (400 VALIDATION_ERROR)
login - malformed JSON (400 VALIDATION_ERROR)
players (contract)
get player - seeded dima_mod (200, the contract example: level 4, xp 1250)
get player - maxim_jr (200, level 2)
get player - veteran at the level cap (200, level 10)
get player - unknown id (404 PLAYER_NOT_FOUND)
get player - malformed id (400 VALIDATION_ERROR)
players CRUD (beyond contract)
create player (201, Location header)
create player - duplicate username (409 USERNAME_TAKEN)
create player - duplicate email (409 EMAIL_TAKEN)
create player - username too short (400 VALIDATION_ERROR, details.field=username)
create player - username with a dash (400 VALIDATION_ERROR)
create player - password too short (400 VALIDATION_ERROR, details.field=password)
create player - email without a domain dot (400 VALIDATION_ERROR)
create player - relative avatar_url (400 VALIDATION_ERROR, details.field=avatar_url)
create player - malformed JSON (400 VALIDATION_ERROR)
list players (200, items + total)
list players - first page of two (200)
list players - second page (200)
list players - offset past the end (200, empty items, total unchanged)
list players - limit above the cap (200, capped at 100)
list players - non-numeric limit (400 VALIDATION_ERROR)
list players - negative offset (400 VALIDATION_ERROR)
get profile - dima_mod (200, no email, no password_hash)
get profile - unknown id (404 PLAYER_NOT_FOUND)
patch profile - bio only, xp untouched (200)
patch profile - display name and avatar (200)
patch profile - change the password (200, hash replaced, never returned)
patch profile - password back to seed-password (200, other collections log in as dima_mod)
patch profile - email taken by another player (409 EMAIL_TAKEN)
patch profile - bad avatar_url (400 VALIDATION_ERROR)
patch profile - another player's id (403 NOT_ACCOUNT_OWNER)
put player (405 METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED)
unknown route (404 NOT_FOUND)
patch profile - another player's token (403 NOT_ACCOUNT_OWNER)
patch profile - no token (401 UNAUTHENTICATED, Gateway)
delete player - another player's token (403 NOT_ACCOUNT_OWNER)
history (beyond contract)
shifts - dima_mod (200, 2 seeded rows, newest first)
shifts - dima_mod, one per page (200)
shifts - maxim_jr (200, 1 seeded row)
shifts - vlad_jr has none (200, empty items - never null)
shifts - unknown id (404 PLAYER_NOT_FOUND)
disciplinary actions - dima_mod (200, 1 seeded warning)
disciplinary actions - repeat_offender (200, 2 warnings, newest first)
disciplinary actions - rookie_one has none (200, empty items)
disciplinary actions - unknown id (404 PLAYER_NOT_FOUND)
friends (beyond contract)
friends - dima_mod (200, maxim_jr and vlad_jr from the seed)
friends - dima_mod, one per page (200)
friends - rookie_one has none (200, empty items)
1. add friend - rookie_one befriends veteran_max (201)
2. friends of rookie_one - now shows veteran_max (200)
3. friends of veteran_max - symmetric, shows rookie_one (200)
4. add the same friend again (409 ALREADY_FRIENDS)
5. add it from the other side - same friendship (409 ALREADY_FRIENDS)
6. remove from the other side (204)
7. friends of rookie_one - gone from both sides (200, empty items)
8. remove again (404 FRIEND_NOT_FOUND)
add friend - self (422 CANNOT_FRIEND_SELF)
add friend - friend_id is the nil UUID (400 VALIDATION_ERROR)
add friend - unknown friend_id (404 FRIEND_NOT_FOUND)
add friend - another player in the path (403 NOT_ACCOUNT_OWNER)
add friend - friend_id absent (400 VALIDATION_ERROR)
add friend - malformed friend_id (400 VALIDATION_ERROR)
friends - unknown id (404 PLAYER_NOT_FOUND)
events - session.ended, as Session Service pushes it (contract)
1. dima_mod and maxim_jr before the event (200, xp 1250 / 640)
2. push session.ended (200, duplicate=false)
3. dima_mod after - xp 1280, completed_shifts 13, still level 4 (200)
4. shift history after - the new row is first (200)
5. disciplinary log after - the warning was appended (200)
6. REPEAT the same event_id (200, duplicate=true - nothing changes)
7. dima_mod after the repeat - unchanged, xp still 1280 (200)
8. shift history after the repeat - still one row for that session (200)
apply - a player id this service does not know (200, skipped and logged)
apply - negative xp_delta, total floored at zero (200)
apply - repeat_offender after the drain (200, xp 0, level 1)
apply - no role field, which the event catalog omits (200)
apply - event type not consumed here (422 INVALID_EVENT)
apply - missing event_id (422 INVALID_EVENT)
apply - payload without session_id (422 INVALID_EVENT)
apply - unknown envelope version (422 INVALID_EVENT)
apply - malformed JSON (422 INVALID_EVENT)
apply - with a player token instead of the service token (403 SERVICE_TOKEN_REQUIRED, Gateway)
dev - task timeout (beyond contract, service token)
slow - within the timeout (200)
slow - past the service's 5s timeout (408 REQUEST_TIMEOUT)
slow - wait above 60000 ms (400 VALIDATION_ERROR)
slow - with a player token (403 SERVICE_TOKEN_REQUIRED, Gateway)
cleanup (destructive - run last)
delete player - veteran_max (204, history and friendships cascade)
delete the same player again (404 PLAYER_NOT_FOUND)
get the deleted player (404 PLAYER_NOT_FOUND)
delete player - malformed id (400 VALIDATION_ERROR)
